sheets.title: PARTIAL MEZZANINE PLAN SURVEY — BLDG. 77H
sheets.reading_notes: Partial mezzanine plan survey covering columns roughly D/E-10 through D/E-18 (west portion). Scale 3/32" = 1'-0". Shows existing electrical devices attached to gypsum roof deck: lighting fixtures (numbered with circled integers), junction boxes (flush-mounted in deck and surface-mounted on steel beams), conduit runs (1/2" embedded in roof deck, 3/4" on steel beams), panel callouts for Panel 'MDP' (600A, 480Y/277V, 3Ø) and Panel 'L-16' (250A, 240/120V, 3Ø) both located on ground floor. Existing 100A, 3Ø elevator disconnect switch to remain. Abandoned mechanical ductwork called out between columns D-16/17 (26"×26"D) and D-17/18 (20"×20"D), with branch ductwork routing to ground floor. Key plan in lower right shows three mezzanine survey zones (this sheet = west zone). BFA PE stamp dated 02-14-2024. NAVFAC MIDLANT client. Sheet key notes describe 17 different existing conditions (attached fixtures, flush boxes, embedded conduit, abandoned ductwork, panels, elevator disconnect, NMCI fiber cabling). Roof type zoning shown at bottom: LOW ROOF, LOW MONITOR ROOF, 40+ MONITOR ROOF — indicating variable roof heights across the mezzanine floor plan.

sheets.title: PARTIAL MEZZANINE PLAN SURVEY — BLDG. 77H
sheets.reading_notes: Partial mezzanine plan survey covering columns D/E-18 through D/E-26 (center portion of mezzanine). Scale 3/32" = 1'-0". Match lines at left (to E-101) and right (to E-103). Very similar inventory to E-101: existing lighting fixtures, junction boxes, conduit. General notes (carried on all sheets) repeat: abandoned mechanical ductwork items D-17/18 through D-22/23 with varying sizes (20"×20"D, 26"×26"D, 29"×32"W, 35"×38"W, 43"×43"W, 44"×46-1/2"W). Sheet key notes identify 12 conditions: abandoned lighting circuits, flush JBs, embedded 1/2" conduit, abandoned conduit with cut-control wiring, HVAC controller conduit (to remain), HVAC controller (to remain), 1×4 lighting fixture on steel beam, steel strut support conduit on stairwell wall, NMCI cabling in corrugated PVC, NMCI pullbox, existing junction box on mechanical equipment (to remove and relocate), 1×4 lighting fixture not operating (to replace lamps). Roof zoning same pattern as E-101 across top of plan.

sheets.title: PARTIAL MEZZANINE PLAN SURVEY — BLDG. 77H + MECHANICAL PENTHOUSE PLAN + LIGHTING ONE-LINE DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Three drawings on this sheet (two pages in PDF): (1) Partial mezzanine plan survey east zone (columns D/E-26 through D/E-31). Match line at left to E-102. Abandoned ductwork items D-26/27 through D-29/30 called out in general notes (44"×41"Wx, 43"×43"Wx, 38"×41"Wx). Sheet key notes: surface JB on steel beam below roof deck, flush JB in roof deck underside, embedded 1/2" empty conduit, embedded 1/2" empty conduit dead-end, abandoned lighting circuit wiring in embedded conduit, 1/2" conduit dead end in mech penthouse, conduit from south face of column D-27 to junction box at mezzanine level then to exterior wall column E-27 and dead-ends at ground floor. (2) Mechanical Penthouse Plan: small plan showing mezzanine platform area near columns D-26/27, with junction boxes, lighting fixture (incandescent bulb), conduit routed down column D-27. (3) Lighting One-Line Diagram (two instances — one for mezzanine lighting circuit, one for elevator circuit): Panel L-16 (250A, 240/120V, 3Ø, ground floor, column B-13) feeding mezzanine lighting circuit L-16-17 with parallel timer switches. Panel MDP (600A, 480Y/277V, 3Ø, ground floor) feeding elevator circuit MDP-38 (100A, 3Ø) through disconnect switch. Confirms panels are ground-floor equipment; circuits traverse to mezzanine level through conduit. BFA PE stamp 02-14-2024.

gross_square_footage.notes: No area tabulation on drawings. Mezzanine plan drawn at 3/32"=1'-0". Bay spacing approximately 20'-0" per dimension callouts. Survey spans columns D/E-10 through D/E-31 (approximately 21 bays). Width not explicitly dimensioned. Could not reliably derive GSF at medium depth without scaling the drawings carefully.
